motor.quote: The Fold 1 packs a punchier motor than we typically see in this category – a 750W rear hub unit (peaking at 1,050W) with 70Nm of torque. While most folders opt for a more modest 500W setup, this beefier motor delivers solid performance across most riding scenarios without feeling like overkill.

motor.basis: rear hub per same review ("a 750W rear-hub motor")

height.quote: The Fold 1 takes a straightforward approach to its model lineup – one size, two colors (blue or grey), and a frame design that fits riders from 4’9″ up to 6’ 5”. No ‘analysis paralysis’ here, though if you’re north of 6’ 5” you might need to get creative for a good fit.
Rider height range: 4’9″ ~ 6’5 ⟶ Total payload capacity: 440 lbs.

fold.quote: 3-Step Folding: Simply unfasten the quick release to lower the stem, tuck in the pedals, and then use the quick release again to collapse the frame. ⟶ A BIKE BUILT FOR YOU

A simple 3-Step folding process with an included retentions strap. The included retention strap seems minor but saves you from that classic folding bike dance where it tries to unfold itself mid-lift.
The Fold has plenty of expected features like a hinged frame and stem, 20×3” knobby tires, a 7-speed drivetrain, hydraulic brakes, and a front suspension.
